scope: Individual revised A7 physical-path and containment theorem audit, including A7-related common README/interfaces/requirements and A5/A8 boundary consistency. No implementation, physical qualification or whole-architecture composition certificate.

findings.reason: Revised text limits the impossibility to endpoints tighter than remaining qualified support and explicitly retains near-endpoint useful narrowness. This matches D5, including a singleton at a monotone support endpoint. No unqualified aging rate is inferred.

The SOC sum is explicitly conditional on dz/dt=-I/(3600Q), interval-effective constant capacity and SOC continuity at capacity boundaries. A general F_k must carry separately selected boundary maps/additional terms for other loss or charge-preservation laws. I_k*dt_k is interpreted as the declared interval current integral under the common qualified acquisition/input semantics, not as a claim that an arbitrary instantaneous sample integrates an arbitrary current waveform.

Given the actual transition belongs to the qualified F_k, initial containment and actual joint input/state admissibility place the successor in the reach outer set. Qualified measurement semantics place it in Y; the stored outer intersection retains it. Induction establishes finite-prefix pathwise containment. Rounding/compression inclusion and the one joint probability event are premises, not proved physical properties.

Reference R increase and Q/C decrease remain hypotheses; tau=R*C has no monotonic direction. Reversible temperature effects, unknown thermal coefficients and current/clock uncertainty are joint physical inputs. Manufacturing spread, engineering support, spline smoothness and knot count do not create a temporal rate or calibrated population law.

Under the declared SOC-continuous convention, the charge-weighted reciprocal-capacity path determines the decrement, so equal final capacity and equal total signed charge do not suffice. Joint chronology and uncertainty remain necessary unless a separately bounded reduction proves otherwise.
findings.algebraic_witness: For three equal charge increments 0.1 in consistent units, monotone capacity paths (2,2,1) and (2,1,1) share initial/final capacity and total charge but give decrements 0.20 and 0.25. At zero current, charge-preserving capacity change 0.06 to 0.05 Ah at SOC 0.4 instead gives SOC 0.48; revised A7 correctly assigns this to a different boundary law.

findings.reason: Voltage preservation and branch-charge C*v preservation require different aging maps. Pole relabeling must transport full branch state/parameters and uncertainty/history to preserve physical response; scalar sorting is explicitly insufficient. The contract leaves selection and qualification open.

Set propagation is not converted into a probability density. The probabilistic alternative retains normalization, support mass, Jacobians and correlations. Historical observations constrain historical states and enter once; a posterior plus its source observations is not independent evidence. No stationary R0 response map is extended to unqualified varying health.

Detected model-support failure suspends affected authorization; history loss requires aged-cell-valid public support. Physical relaxation does not erase information/error. Useful reacquisition needs achievable excitation, power and service deadlines from A5/A8. B_PHYSICAL/B_SENSOR/B_AGING/B_ACTION/B_RISK and associated availability/platform blockers remain explicit; there is no promise of detecting every latent physical model failure.

validation.method: Premise-by-premise handwritten mathematical/physical contract audit against reviewed D1/D5, stationary R0 and earlier SOC-continuity qualification; original snapshot hash verification; algebraic counterexamples revisited.
validation.artifact_policy: Exclusively create this new receipt; do not modify original reviews, snapshots, specifications, implementation or results.

remaining_application_obligations: Qualify actual physical battery/use/thermal/input/noise family, joint initial support and valid evolution relation.
Select SOC/capacity and RC boundary transport, pole identity and thermal/aging correlations with independent evidence.
Provide quantitative temporal restrictions when remaining support is too broad for useful quiet-use queries.
Prove numerical/representation outer inclusions or probability-law fidelity and the simultaneous-risk event.
Validate sensor drift, temperature cycles, aged-cell reset, path-order effects and achievable useful recovery.
Complete continuous-shape representation, lifetime availability and full target-memory/service obligations separately.
remaining_limits: Acceptance is bound to listed exact reviewed hashes and conditional premises; substantive changes require renewed review.
No qualified aging rate, forgetting factor, process noise, knot count or deployable physical law is supplied.
No implementation correspondence, calibrated physical coverage, ten-year performance or M23 qualification is claimed.
Common interfaces/requirements were inspected for A7 consistency only; this is not whole-contract-set composition acceptance.
